name: Uqua: Inner Sanctum of the Ocean God
summary: The Ocean God’s sacred inner domain, where planar water energy concentrates and Discord corruption threatens total collapse.
description: The Inner Sanctum is the heart of Uqua’s divine architecture. Massive stone pillars rise from deep water, carved with ancient depictions of the Ocean God’s dominion. Planar water energy flows through elevated conduits, forming spirals and rising tides that defy gravity. Discord corruption has twisted the sanctum, destabilizing its rituals and spawning powerful aquatic manifestations. Ocean Cult guardians defend the sanctum with fanatical devotion, while Muramite forces attempt to breach its defenses. The sanctum is a volatile battleground of divine magic, planar water instability, and catastrophic Discord surges.
